name: luff-crew-monitor
description: Live crew panel inside Claude: every subagent with model, effort, steps, context, estimated cost and time, plus a job bar above the prompt and your 5-hour and weekly plan limits. /agents-info toggles it; /agents-web opens an optional browser view.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

stepReports.title: Subagent step reports
stepReports.description: How often subagents report their steps to the panel (each report is one more model request): off, light (start and halfway) or full (every step)
